en: A black-and-white image depicting a large, multi-story institutional building with a neoclassical architectural style. The structure has many windows, a stone base, and a plain facade. There is a paved street with tram tracks and a few pedestrians, including a group of people with a cart. The scene is urban, and the trees lining the street are leafless, suggesting early spring or late autumn. There are no visible signs or text on the building or in the image.
